name: SX127x Packet Transport Platform
description: The [Packet Transport](https://esphome.io/components/packet_transport/) platform allows ESPHome nodes to directly communicate with each over a communication channel. The [Sx127X](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x/) implementation of the platform uses FSK, OOK or LoRa as a communication medium. See the [Packet Transport](https://esphome.io/components/packet_transport/) and [Sx127X](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x/) for more information.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: Interval between full broadcasts. Defaults to 15s.

config_entries.label: Binary Sensors
config_entries.description: A list of binary sensor IDs to be broadcast.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The id of the binary sensor to be used

config_entries.label: Broadcast ID
config_entries.description: The id to be used for this binary sensor in the broadcast. Defaults to the same as the internal id.

config_entries.label: Encryption
config_entries.description: The encryption key to use when broadcasting. Default is no encryption. This may be any string, and will be hashed to form a 256 bit key.

config_entries.label: Ping Pong Enable
config_entries.description: When set, requires encrypted providers to include a *nonce* generated by this device in broadcasts. Defaults to `false`. Can be set only on the consumer side.

config_entries.label: Ping Pong Recycle Time
config_entries.description: Controls how often the ping-pong key is regenerated. Requires `ping_pong_enable` to be set. Defaults to 10 minutes. Can be set only on the consumer side.

config_entries.label: Providers
config_entries.description: A list of provider device names and optionally their secret encryption keys.

config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The device name of the provider.

config_entries.label: Rolling Code Enable
config_entries.description: Enables a rolling code to be included in all broadcasts. Requires `encryption` to be set. Defaults to `false`. Can be set only on the provider side.

config_entries.label: Sensors
config_entries.description: A list of sensor IDs to be broadcast. Each entry may be just the sensor id, or may set a different id to be broadcast.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The id of the sensor to be used

config_entries.label: Broadcast ID
config_entries.description: The id to be used for this sensor in the broadcast. Defaults to the same as the internal id.
